availability: Reviewed report outcomes add Saffire-II fabric, BASS-II PMMA slabs, FLEX heptane droplets, and USML-1 candle observations. These remain evidence-only; test geometry and metric units are preserved. PSI tables and metadata remain staged as described in DATA_INVENTORY.md. The Saffire-II workbook indexes frames with missing reference imagery and timing. SAME and SPICE provide staged conditions, while SPICE analysis and BASS tomography have metadata only.
